draft.emotion: friendly and open, looking straight at someone
notes: Mặt most commonly refers to the human face, but it is also widely used for the surface of objects (like water or tables) and the front side of things.

senses.definition: The front part of the head, from the forehead to the chin.

examples.text: Cô ấy lấy tay che mặt vì ngại.
examples.translation: She covered her face with her hands because she was shy.
examples.emotion: bashful and smiling, hiding behind hands

senses.definition: The outside or top boundary of an object or liquid.

examples.text: Mặt nước phẳng lặng như gương.
examples.translation: The surface of the water is as flat and calm as a mirror.
examples.emotion: calm and appreciative, looking at a quiet lake

senses.definition: One of the flat sides of a geometric object or paper.

examples.text: Hãy viết tên bạn ở mặt sau của tờ giấy.
examples.translation: Please write your name on the back side of the paper.
examples.emotion: instructional and clear, pointing to a sheet of paper
